reference.method: unit-tests + live isolated dev-server probes (3 boots, temp DATA_DIR, ports 21151-21153)

queryParams.limit: positive int, clamped to 10000; missing/invalid => full list
queryParams.after: model id cursor; unknown id => start at 0
queryParams.configuredOnly: 'true' => keep only models with an eligible DB connection
queryParams.client_version: opaque; only signals Codex CLI refresh (shape change is header-driven, not param-driven)

codexClientAdds.models: empty array, ONLY when originator^=codex* or user-agent^=codex*

alwaysPresent.created: integer unix seconds, single timestamp shared by whole response
alwaysPresent.owned_by: string (canonical provider id, node prefix, or 'combo')

usuallyPresent.permission: array (ALWAYS [] when present; ABSENT on specialty-registry rows: embedding/image/rerank/audio/moderation/video/music)
usuallyPresent.root: string raw model id (absent on some specialty rows)
usuallyPresent.parent: string|null (alias->canonical linkage; null or absent otherwise)

success.ordering: combo-owned rows first (auto/* then user combos), then provider-grouped by owned_by in registry precedence (OAUTH->NOAUTH->APIKEY), unknown groups by code-unit order; stable within group (NO global alpha sort; JSON key order not significant)
success.dedupe: first wins per (id,type,subtype); generic chat sibling dropped when a typed specialty row shares the id; intentional audio transcription/speech pair kept
success.emptyCatalog: 200 with data:[] (reachable: all providers blocked/hidden, hideAutoCombos, no combos; never observed live — source-derived)

viaProxy: access-control-allow-origin (echo iff credentialed request or preflight; '*' iff no Origin on relaxed surface; ABSENT for credential-less GET — fail-closed)

pipeline.allowAnonymousWhen: no bearer AND no dashboard session AND REQUIRE_API_KEY=false (default)
pipeline.rejectInvalidKey: 401 AUTH_002 'Invalid API key' (invalid key degrades to anonymous iff REQUIRE_API_KEY=false)

route.openWhen: requireLogin===false OR fresh-install public-route (/api/v1/* prefix, no password/OIDC/INITIAL_PASSWORD anywhere) OR settings.requireAuthForModels===false
route.rejectInvalidKey: 401 same shape, message 'Invalid API key' (validateApiKey incl. env key OMNIROUTE_API_KEY/ROUTER_API_KEY)
route.acceptedCredentialScope: Authorization Bearer; x-api-key ONLY with anthropic-version header or claude-code/claude-cli/anthropic UA; x-goog-api-key; /vscode/<key>/ path token. Query-string ?token= etc. REMOVED (#3300)
route.perKeyScoping: allowedModels/blockedModels patterns filter rows (id or root); quota-exclusive keys list ONLY qtSd/* pool models; env-key (no DB row) sees full catalog

methods.HEAD: 200 application/json, empty body (explicit handler, #6400); gated by pipeline auth when REQUIRE_API_KEY=true (live: 401), open otherwise
methods.OPTIONS: 204 preflight (route: Allow-Methods GET,HEAD,OPTIONS + Allow-Headers *; proxy overlays origin)

cache.responseMemo: Map keyed by prefix|isCodex|HMAC-fp(apiKey)|configuredOnly|hideAuto|hideNoThink|page; TTL settings.cache.modelCatalogCacheTtlMs else 60s; stale-while-revalidate 30s via after() (post-flush), errors never served stale
cache.coalescing: concurrent identical builds share one promise (#6408); generation-guarded against post-write joins (#12627 8s bound)
cache.invalidation: invalidateDbCache() bumps modelCatalogCacheVersion on settings/connections/combos/pricing/nodes/model-capability writes; readCache TTLs 5s (settings/connections/nodes) / 30s (pricing)
cache.postResponse: after() background refresh only; cc-discovery metric increment (fire-and-forget)

notTouched: no upstream fetch on this path (OpenRouter live catalog ONLY when openrouter active without synced models; AI Horde ensureFresh ONLY when aihorde active)
no writes except cc-discovery counter + last-used key stamp

liveObservationsThisEnv.note: ENVIRONMENT-SPECIFIC, not requirements: fresh boot, no connections/combos

compatibilitySurface: docs/native-backend/contracts/v1-models-compatibility-surface.contract.json (Task 004: alias, HEAD, OPTIONS, methods, trailing-slash, case, query, 404 boundary, auth ordering)

unresolved: truly-passwordless fresh-install loopback 200 NOT live-probed (repo .env injects INITIAL_PASSWORD=CHANGEME; covered by source gates + cited unit test)
503 build-timeout + last-good fallback NOT triggered live (cold builds 1.4-4.4s < 8s bound; covered by 12627-catalog-inflight-timeout.test.ts)
